site.language_hint: The language of these screens for everyone who has picked none of their own.
site.logo_chosen: As it will be kept: {width} by {height} pixels, {kib} KiB. It is not saved yet.
site.logo_hint: Any picture will do, of any size: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG. Crop it here to what is to be kept; the page makes it small enough, a PNG of {width} by {height} pixels and {kib} KiB at most. It stands where the usher's mark does, as high as a line of the bar, so a wide logo with little room around it reads best. One with a clear ground stands on dark pages and on light.
site.logo_none: No logo is set. The usher wears its own mark.
site.logo_on_dark: The logo on a dark page
site.logo_on_light: The logo on a light page
site.logo_removed: The logo is removed. The usher wears its own mark.
site.logo_set: The logo that is set: {width} by {height} pixels, {kib} KiB.
site.name: Name
site.name_hint: What this place is called, {most} characters at most. It stands in the bar, on the form people sign in by, and above a voucher shown to a guest. Left empty, the usher goes by its own name.
site.title: Name, time zone, language and logo
site.zone_hint: Every time on these screens is shown in it. With each browser's own, a screen shows a time as its browser keeps it.
site.zone_hint_here: Every time on these screens is shown in it. With each browser's own, a screen shows a time as its browser keeps it; this browser keeps {zone}.
travel.applied_but: The profile is applied, but for what follows.
travel.exported_unit: Everything is exported, sealed, as {file}. Keep the file and its passphrase apart.
travel.holds_site: the site's name, time zone and language
travel.holds_unit: It also holds a unit, sealed. That part is not applied here: a new unit is set up from it.
travel.intro: What this site is set up as can be given to another unit as a file, and this whole unit can be moved to another machine.
travel.move_hint: Everything this unit keeps, in one file: its people, its satellites, its controller and the key to it, the vouchers set aside, the record of hand-outs, and what its certificate is signed by. The file is sealed under a passphrase you choose. A new unit is set up from it, with "Set up from a file", and is then this unit: people sign in as before, and the satellites go on with no visit.
travel.not_a_file: That file could not be read as an usher's file.
travel.passphrase_hint: {least} characters or more. Whoever has the file and its passphrase has the unit: keep them apart.
travel.passphrases_differ: The two passphrases are not the same. Type them again.
travel.profile_hint: The voucher types, and the site's name, time zone, language and logo, in one file. It holds no secret and nothing of this unit's own, and is safe to keep anywhere. Applied to a unit, it adds and sets, and takes nothing away.
travel.refused_enabled: {name} was not enabled or disabled as the file says: {why}
travel.refused_order: The order of the voucher types was not set: {why}
travel.refused_site: The site's name, time zone and language were not set: {why}
travel.refused_type: The voucher type {name} was not taken: {why}

types.deleted: {name} is deleted. Vouchers already issued as {name} stay as they are.
types.devices_to_choose: Devices to choose from: 2 or more.
types.disabled_done: {name} is disabled: the front desk is not offered it.
types.enabled_done: {name} is enabled: the front desk is offered it.

types.name_stays: A type is known by its name, which stays. For another name, add a type and delete this one.
types.needs_name: A voucher type needs a name.

types.rate: {what}: megabits per second, as 7.2; empty for no limit.
